messages:
laura: Quick reminder — cutoff today @ 17:00 UTC. We need final lockfile + submodule syncs pushed before then. Who's on the dependency bumps?

mike: working on the lib-telemetry bump. PR is open: https://github.com/redwoodinc/lib-telemetry/pull/412 — waiting on one review and a green CI.

shen: submodule update required for third_party/kvstore. I have the branch ready but need to rebase against release/v1.9. Planning to push in ~30m.

anita: FYI CI is failing on flaky macos build for the vendor image after the telemetry bump. stacktrace in the job logs: ``error: symbol lookup failed: some_lib.o``

ci-bot: build #4827 — macos-x86_64 — FAILED (tests/resource_loader) — https://ci.redwood/internal/4827

mike: ack, i'll roll back the telemetry patch that touches the packaging script and re-run. If that fixes it I'll re-add as a tiny patch.

sam: for changelog: please add a short entry under "deps" if we actually land the kvstore update. One-line is fine.

laura: @mike can you add the changelog entry in the same PR? keeps the changelog -> lockfile link tidy. If CI still flakes, we may need to gate on the macos job and move forward with everything else.

disha: I can do the merge at cutoff+10 if approvals and CI are green. I'll be watching the queue.

mike: i pushed a revert of the packaging tweak, retriggered CI: https://ci.redwood/internal/4830 — macos job queued.

ci-bot: build #4830 — macos queued

shen: pushed submodule update: refs/heads/release-sync/kvstore-2.1.0 -> needs a merge commit on release/v1.9. I'm leaving a note in the PR about the canonical sha.

anita: after the revert macos is green locally, but the CI worker still times out occasionally. if it flakes again we should skip the flaky test and add a TODO.

laura: decision: if macos flakes twice in a row we'll skip that test for this cut (add TODO + ticket to re-enable). Otherwise we wait for green. Everyone okay?

sam: +1 — make the TODO ticket and link it in the PR body.

mike: will do. also adding the changelog line to the same PR now.

disha: i'll stand by to merge. can someone @ me on the PR once it's green and approved?

laura: @disha yes — i'll ping once CI is green and we have 1 approval. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
